title: Putnami Workspace Probe Result
description: Workspace probe protocol v1. A provider (extension) answers core's ProbeRequest with this result: what it knows about each candidate project directory, addressed by repo-relative path. Core alone assigns canonical paths and IDs; providers contribute source identity, derived dependency paths, publish/runs-with metadata, requested extension references, watched files, and opaque provider-owned metadata.

version.description: Probe protocol version. A mismatch is rejected, never guessed at.

extension.description: Name of the answering extension. Keys the provider-owned metadata bucket in the merged view.

projects.description: Per-directory findings, joined across providers by path.

watchedFiles.description: Repo-relative files whose content changes this provider's answer independently of any single project (a workspace lockfile, a root toolchain config).

diagnostics.description: Provider-side findings. Advisory prose: deliberately excluded from the probe digest so a reworded warning cannot cold a cache key.

dependencySource.description: Where one dependency edge came from: a declaration, a go.mod require or replace, a package.json dependency on a workspace package, or a generated client's committed contract.

providerDependencySource.description: The subset of dependencySource a provider may claim. The contract source is core's own derivation and belongs to no provider's answer.

relativePath.description: Repo-relative, slash-separated path inside the workspace. The pattern only rejects the two shapes a plain regex can catch (a leading separator, a backslash-rooted path); the full rule — no absolute paths, no backslashes anywhere, no escape above the root — is enforced by the Go validator. Absolute paths, backslashes, and paths escaping the root are rejected: they would make a digest depend on where the repository is checked out or on the host OS.

extension.description: Target extension name, echoed back in the result so a misrouted response is detectable.

reason.description: Why core is probing. Advisory and never digested. 'plan' marks a --plan/--dry-run probe whose result must not be persisted.

paths.description: Repo-relative candidate project directories core already knows about. A provider may report a subset; it may not invent a project outside this set.

files.description: Repo-relative files core has already observed. Hints only: a provider that ignores them must still produce the same result.

dependencySources.description: Ask the provider to attribute every edge it reports (probeProject.dependencySources). Core sets it only for a provider whose manifest declares the capability; a provider strips the attribution from any answer to a request that did not ask, so a strict core that predates the member never receives it.

probeProject.description: What one provider knows about one project directory. The project root is NOT assumed to be the provider's own unit root: sourceFile may sit arbitrarily deep below path, and dependencies are project paths rather than module identifiers.

path.description: Repo-relative project directory; the join key across providers. '.' is the canonical spelling of the workspace root.

sourceName.description: Identity the provider's own manifest declares (go.mod module, package.json name, pyproject name). Outranks a scope namePattern, never an explicit putnami.json name.

sourceFile.description: Repo-relative file sourceName was read from. May be nested below path.

dependencies.description: Repo-relative PATHS of workspace projects this project depends on. Providers resolve their own module graph to paths; core resolves paths to projects.

dependencySources.description: Manifest family each reported dependency edge was derived from, keyed by the same repo-relative path. A dependency absent from this map is declared: the provider read it from a declaration rather than from an import. It never changes which edges are reported.

runsWith.description: Serve-mode service dependencies the provider derives.

watchedFiles.description: Repo-relative files whose content changes this project's probe answer or invalidates its work. Workspace-root entries also map otherwise-unowned root changes back to this project.

metadata.description: Provider-owned opaque data. Core never interprets it; it is carried under project.metadata[<extension>] and hashed canonically.

mergedProject.description: Core's merged view of one project directory after folding every provider's answer and the explicitly authored putnami.json.

dependencySources.description: Union of the providers' edge provenance, keyed by the same repo-relative paths dependencies carries. An edge only the authored putnami.json declares is absent from it.

metadata.description: Provider-owned metadata bucketed by extension name, so two providers can never collide.

probeFailure.description: Typed, causal probe failure. Graph-dependent commands fail with this attached; recovery commands stay available.

diagnostics.description: Underlying validation findings, when the failure came from rejecting a payload.
